create_AssignResult: create an AssignResult instance storing assignments between predicted and ground truth bounding boxes
generate_random_AssignResult: generate a random AssignResult for testing with configurable num_gts, num_preds, and assignment probabilities
add_ground_truth_to_AssignResult: add ground truth labels to an existing AssignResult by concatenating gt_inds, max_overlaps, and labels
get_AssignResult_info: get a dictionary of info about an AssignResult including num_gts, num_preds, gt_inds, max_overlaps, and labels
set_extra_property_on_AssignResult: set a user-defined extra property on an AssignResult instance using a key-value pair
